τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη)
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τούτῳ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. dat. sg.
τοὔνεκά: τοὔνεκα (τοῦ + ἕνεκα, crasis) — therefore, for that reason; adv., accented before the enclitic οἱ · also accented before the enclitic μιν (τοὔνεκά μιν κάλεον ’for that reason they called him’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board)
τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
τρῳαὶ: Τρῳάς — Trojan woman; fem. nom. pl., Ionic Τρῳαί
τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τυδέος: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. gen. sg. (Τυδέος υἱός ’son of Tydeus’, periphrasis for Diomedes)
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’, often with γε: ’that at least’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg., inner object: ’which’ (ἕλκος τό μιν βάλε ’the wound with which he struck him’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, ’on that account’ (τό γε δείδιθι ’fear not on that account’)
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much, so greatly’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’so many’ · also adverbial, correlative with ὅσσον: ’so far’
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’)
τῷδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. dat. sg., elided (τῷδ’ = τῷδε)
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.
φιλέουσά: φιλέω — love, treat kindly; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., uncontracted (= φιλοῦσα)
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φρένες: φρήν — mind, heart, midriff (seat of feeling); fem. nom. pl.
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
φῦ: φύω — grow, put forth; aor. 3 sg. root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔφυ), intransitive; ἔν … φῦ in tmesis (= ἐνέφυ): ’clung to’
χέουσα: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’pouring, shedding’
χαλκοκορυστῇ: χαλκοκορυστής — armed in bronze; masc. dat. sg., epithet
χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
χθόνα: χθών — earth, ground; fem. acc. sg.: ’onto the earth’
ἀγυιάς: ἀγυιά — street, highway; fem. acc. pl.
ἀθηναίης: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. gen. sg., Ionic-epic form (= Attic Ἀθηνᾶς)
ἀλέξανδρος: Ἀλέξανδρος — Alexander, the other name of Paris, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἀλεξάνδρου: Ἀλέξανδρος — Alexander, the other name of Paris; masc. gen. sg.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμφ: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., elided (ἀμφ’) · also prep. + dat., ’about, on’ (ἀμφ’ ὀβελοῖσιν ’on spits’)
ἀμύμονα: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (traditional sense; exact meaning uncertain); adj. of two endings, acc. sg. (masc./fem.) · also neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἀνέμοιο: ἄνεμος — wind; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀνθρώποισι: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. gen. pl.
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’
ἀπέβη: ἀποβαίνω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀπ-έ-βη)
ἀπέλυσε: ἀπολύω — set free, release; aor. 3 sg. act.
ἀπερείσι: ἀπερείσιος — boundless, unstinted; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἀπερείσι’ = ἀπερείσια)
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg.
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’)
ἂρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, grave form ἂρ
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄκοιτις: ἄκοιτις — wife, bedfellow; fem. nom. sg.
ἄκουσε: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤκουσε)
ἄλκιμον: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, staunch (from ἀλκή); neut. acc. sg.
ἄλλη: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. sg., distributive: ἄλλη δ’ ἄλλων γλῶσσα ’each tongue differing from the others’
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλοισι: ἄλλος — other; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἄλοχόν: ἄλοχος — wife, spouse; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
ἄνδρεσσιν: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ἀνδράσι)
ἄποινα: ἄποινα — ransom (a neuter plural noun); nom./acc. pl.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl. of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. pl.
ἄρτεμις: Ἄρτεμις — Artemis, goddess of the hunt and of sudden painless death (esp. of women); fem. nom. sg.
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἄχε: ἄχος — pain, grief, distress; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted and elided (ἄχε’ = ἄχεα; Attic ἄχη): ’griefs’
ἄϊδος: Ἅιδης (Ἄϊς) — Hades; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄϊδος (Attic Ἅιδου)
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time, along; adv./prep. + dat.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐμεῖο: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμεῖο (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’) · also dat. governed by ὑπό: ’under me’ (ὑπ’ ἐμοὶ δμηθέντα ’subdued under me’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐναντίη: ἐναντίος — opposite, face to face; fem. nom. sg., predicative: ’face to face, to meet him’
ἐνείκεσας: νεικέω — quarrel with, revile; aor. 2 sg., augmented (cf. unaugmented νείκεσσεν)
ἐξενάριξε: ἐξεναρίζω — slay and strip of arms; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’killed and stripped’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’)
ἐπέεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπέσσυται: ἐπισεύομαι — rush upon, urge on; perf. pass. 3 sg., epic -σσ-: ’is driven on, is set upon’
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπειγέσθω: ἐπείγω — press, urge; mid. hurry, hasten; pres. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let (him) hasten’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐσσομένοισι: εἰμί — be; fut. part. masc. dat. pl., epic ἐσσομένοισι (= Attic ἐσομένοις): ’to those yet to be’
ἐϊκυῖα: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐϊκυῖα (= Attic ἐοικυῖα): ’like’
ἐϋκτιμένας: ἐΰκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded; adj., fem. acc. pl., epic ἐϋ- (= εὖ)
ἐϋπέπλων: ἐΰπεπλος — well-robed, fair-robed; fem. gen. pl. (two-ending adj.)
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἐῢ: ἐΰς — good; neut. ἐῢ used as adv. ’well’ (= εὖ)
ἑλένη: Ἑλένη — Helen, wife of Menelaus; fem. nom. sg.
ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist (= ἔβη): ’went’
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔθελον: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; impf. 1 sg. (same form 3 pl.), unaugmented (= Attic ἤθελον)
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen. · also preverb in tmesis (ἔκ … ἐρέω = ἐξερέω ’I shall speak out’)
ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
ἔμελλε: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to (+ inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’was about to’
ἔν: ἐν — in, among; prep. + dat., accented ἔν before the enclitic τε (ἔν τε ’and among’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ἔν … φῦ = ἐνέφυ)
ἔναιεν: ναίω — dwell, live; impf. 3 sg., augmented, ν-movable: ’lived’
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθά: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔνισπε: ἐνέπω — tell, relate; aor. 3 sg. (2nd aor. ἔνισπον): ’told’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. ἔνισπε: ’tell!’
ἔντεσι: ἔντεα — armour, gear; neut. pl., dat. -εσι: ’in armour’
ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become; aor. 3 sg. mid., no augment, with pres. force or gnomic in a simile: ’comes to be, is’ · also ordinary past: ’came to be’
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔστη: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood, took his stand’
ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., accented ἔστι at clause start: existential, ’there is’ · also impersonal + inf.: ’it is possible’ (οὐδέ πῃ ἔστι … εὐχετάασθαι)
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχουσ: ἔχω — have, hold, carry; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἔχουσ’ = ἔχουσα): ’holding’
ἔχουσιν: ἔχω — have, hold, occupy; pres. 3 pl. act.: ’they hold’
ἕκτορ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. voc. sg., in address
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕνεκ: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., elided (ἕνεκ’ = ἕνεκα)
ἠέ: ἠέ — than (after a comparative); epic form of ἤ
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠετίωνος: Ἠετίων — Eëtion, king of Thebe, father of Andromache; masc. gen. sg.
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’
ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἤντησ: ἀντάω (ἀντιάω) — meet, encounter (+ gen.); aor. 1 sg., elided (ἤντησ’ = ἤντησα): ’I met’
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’)
ἰδομενῆα: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, leader of the Cretans; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰλίου: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. gen. sg.
ἰοχέαιρα: ἰοχέαιρα — arrow-pourer, shooter of arrows (epithet of Artemis); fem. nom. sg.
ἰών: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἰῷ: ἰός — arrow; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with an arrow’ (not ἰός ’poison’)
ἴδωμαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., with future force: ’shall I see’
ἴθ: εἶμι — go; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἴθ’ = ἴθι): ’go! come!’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἵκανε: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg.: ’came to, reached’
ὀΐεσσι: ὄϊς — sheep; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic οἰσί)
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀνόμαζε: ὀνομάζω — call by name, speak; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὠνόμαζε); ἔκ τ’ ὀνόμαζε ’spoke out, named’ in tmesis
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
ὁδὸν: ὁδός — way, journey; fem. acc. sg.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄρος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg.
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’)
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ᾔδη: οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 sg. with past sense (= impf.): ’knew’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
